## About

Alejandro Anchundia is a frontend developer and Web3 developer. He builds digital products with React and TypeScript, ranging from SaaS platforms to Web3 protocols on Solana. He is currently developing LatamLink Pay, a stablecoin point-of-sale system on Solana for Latin American merchants, accepted into the Solana Latam Labs program.

## Skills

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Native / Expo
- Web3 & Backend: Solana, Anchor, Rust, Web3.js, NestJS, REST APIs, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Gemini AI

## Projects

- **EduPlatform** — E-learning platform with role-based dashboards, full authentication and REST architecture. First place winner, Alura Latam Hackathon. https://github.com/anchundiatech/E-Learning-Platform
- **LatamLink Pay** — Stablecoin POS system on Solana for Latin American merchants. Accepted into Solana Latam Labs. https://frontend-latam-link.vercel.app/
- **GitMood** — Real-time GitHub commit sentiment analysis, built solo for the midudev hackathon. https://github.com/anchundiatech/GitMood
- **MediLink** — Health portal for appointment management and telemedicine, built with React, Vite and Tailwind CSS. https://github.com/anchundiatech/MediLink-Frontend
- **Nexum** — Decentralized payment protocol on Solana Devnet using Anchor, Rust and Borsh. https://github.com/anchundiatech/NeXum
- **BlackBox Fleet** — Fleet management SaaS with custom hooks, advanced pagination and CI/CD on Vercel. https://github.com/anchundiatech/i006-blackbox-fullstack-
